section.p: We acknowledge and respect the Lək̓ʷəŋən (Songhees and Xʷsepsəm/Esquimalt) Peoples on whose territory the university stands, and the Lək̓ʷəŋən and W̱SÁNEĆ Peoples whose historical relationships with the land continue to this day.

Shaping the Future of Research Assessment will take place at the University of Victoria on June 8–10, 2027, beginning with a welcome reception on the evening of June 8 followed by two days of workshop programming on June 9 and 10.
The workshop will be held at the UVic University Club, located on West Campus Way.
Eduroam is available on campus for visitors from participating institutions. You may also connect to UVic’s free guest Wi-Fi, UVicStart.
